about.title: About RiC-CM NavTool
about.subtitle: An interactive educator for the Records in Contexts Conceptual Model
about.description: RiC-CM NavTool helps browse RiC-CM entities, attributes, relations, and relation attributes.
about.departmentName: Department of Information Science — Ionian University
about.laboratoryName: Laboratory of Digital Libraries and Electronic Publishing
about.creator: Creator

entitiesView.title: Entities
entitiesView.intro: Explore the building blocks of the conceptual model and understand how they fit together.
entitiesView.browseHint: Select an entity to open its complete definition.

attributesView.title: Attributes
attributesView.intro: Discover the properties used to describe RiC-CM entities.
attributesView.browseHint: Select an attribute code to inspect its definition and usage.

relationsView.title: Relations
relationsView.intro: Follow the meaningful connections between RiC-CM entities, from domain to range.
relationsView.browseHint: Select a relation code to explore its inverse, scope, and hierarchy.

relationAttributesView.title: Relation Attributes
relationAttributesView.intro: Explore the properties that add precision and context to RiC-CM relations.
relationAttributesView.browseHint: Select a card to inspect specifications, scope notes, and examples.

relationAttributeCard.educationalText: Relation attributes qualify connections between entities and add context and nuance to their meaning.

home.title: Explore RiC-CM
home.description: Understand the Records in Contexts Conceptual Model by exploring its entities, attributes and relations through guided discovery.
home.graphAria: A visual map connecting RiC-CM to Record, Agent, Place, Event, Record Set and Function entities
home.pathIntro: Guided ways to build your understanding of RiC-CM, from core concepts to hands-on modeling.
home.entitiesDescription: Discover the main classes of things that RiC-CM describes, with clear definitions and examples.
home.attributesDescription: Learn how attributes describe entities and capture the information that gives them meaning.
home.relationsDescription: Understand how entities connect and how relation attributes add context to those connections.
home.playgroundDescription: Apply what you have learned by building and exploring your own RiC-CM models.

playground.label: Label

entitiesView.title: Entidades
entitiesView.intro: Explora los componentes básicos del modelo conceptual y comprende cómo encajan entre sí.
entitiesView.browseHint: Selecciona una entidad para abrir su definición completa.

attributesView.title: Atributos
attributesView.intro: Descubre las propiedades utilizadas para describir las entidades RiC-CM.
attributesView.browseHint: Selecciona el código de un atributo para consultar su definición y uso.

relationsView.title: Relaciones
relationsView.intro: Sigue las conexiones significativas entre entidades RiC-CM, desde el dominio hasta el rango.
relationsView.browseHint: Selecciona el código de una relación para explorar su inversa, alcance y jerarquía.

relationAttributesView.title: Atributos de relación
relationAttributesView.intro: Explora las propiedades que aportan precisión y contexto a las relaciones RiC-CM.
relationAttributesView.browseHint: Selecciona una tarjeta para consultar especificaciones, notas de alcance y ejemplos.

relationAttributeCard.educationalText: Los atributos de relación califican las conexiones entre entidades y aportan contexto y matices a su significado.
